sections.title: Short title and extent
sections.text:
(1) This Act may be called the Supreme Court (Enlargement of Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction) Act, 1970.
(2) It extends to the whole of India ***.

sections.title: Enlarged appellate jurisdiction of Supreme Court in regard to criminal matters
